subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Training Gadgets, Men’s Work That Actually Works, The New Web, and More

bullets.section: Training and rehab gadget I’m testing
bullets.title: KAATSU
bullets.note: I’ve long been interested in blood-flow restriction (BFR) training, mostly for more gains with fewer injuries. This is particularly true after something like surgery. Since my Humpty Dumpty elbow was surgically repaired six weeks ago, BFR is once again top of mind, and I decided to test [the C4 unit from Kaatsu](https://kaatsu.com/products/kaatsu-c4), based on a few docs and coaches recommendations. There are also newer, cordless/tube-free versions. The jury is still out, but the results are promising. [Here’s a decent overview of the science behind BFR](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8811521/) and its many applications.

bullets.title: AI is killing the web. Can anything save it?
bullets.note: (_The Economist_). [Alternate link](https://archive.is/H2G0Q) if blocked. This is an important facet of the AI conversation that should get more airtime. What happens when the commercial lifeblood of much of the web—advertising and subscriptions—gets replaced by LLMs? What happens if Google, Wikipedia, and many more get wholly or partially displaced? For a quick teaser with some eye-popping numbers, [watch this short clip from Matthew Prince, CEO of Cloudflare](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DPw8r_rDGUc/). As always, I think there are opportunities hiding in the disruption.

bullets.title: Tu Rumba
bullets.creator: iLe
bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RTzL-G2kIA8), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/4iY6Xv5g3SbauDZmCf2kr4)) by [iLe](https://ilevitable.com/) ([@cabralu](https://www.instagram.com/cabralu/)). Give this a chance. The vocals are pure caramel, and it takes 30–60 seconds to warm up. I highly suggest YouTube for both the video and the lyrics in the description. This is an excellent slow-mo song for studying Spanish, even if iLe/Ileana loves to eat her _s_’s. It’s part of her charm.

bullets.title: All Kings, a Retreat for Men, Tackles Masculine Rage, Sadness and Trauma
bullets.creator: Joseph Bernstein
bullets.note: (_The New York Times_; [alternate link](https://archive.ph/fWfXb)). This is a great complement to [_The Work_](https://www.amazon.com/Work-James-McLeary/dp/B077GGWH8P/) documentary I featured in this newsletter long ago, which will tear your heart apart and put it back together. I am going to donate $10,000 to [All Kings](https://www.allkings.org/), a nonprofit organization, as I believe in the mission. Every $1,000 sponsors a new member.
